message.reasoning_content:
The claim: "The growth mindset intervention improved grades equally in every school, regardless of peer norms."

The passages say:
[1] The study identified school contexts that sustained the effects: the intervention changed grades when peer norms aligned with the messages of the intervention. This directly contradicts the claim that effects were equal regardless of peer norms — the effect depended on peer norms.
[2] Says the intervention can increase grades and identified types of school poised to benefit most — again, heterogeneity.
[3] Improved grades among lower-achieving students — qualified.

So the claim is contradicted by passage [1]. The verdict should be "not_supported" with passage 1, since the passage states effects depended on peer norms alignment, contradicting "equally in every school, regardless of peer norms."
